title: A Busy Lesson
setting: A bright classroom with desks, a big world map and a board.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt)

sentences.en: Ben and Mia sit in the classroom.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) sit at their desks in a bright classroom with a big world map on the wall.

sentences.en: Mister Kofi teaches them the alphabet first.
sentences.zh: 科菲先生先教他们字母表。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) stands at the board pointing at a long row of colourful cards in front of Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans).
sentences.draw_note: Shows the teacher pointing at a row of cards on the board; the letters can't be shown.

sentences.en: The children repeat each letter after him.
sentences.zh: 孩子们跟着他重复每个字母。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) speak together with open mouths while Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) points at the cards on the board.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children speaking after the teacher; what they say can't be shown.

sentences.en: Then he reads a sentence as an example.
sentences.zh: 然后他读了一个句子作为例子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) reads aloud from an open book in front of the class.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the teacher reading aloud; the sentence and 'example' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Next is a geography lesson about rivers.
sentences.zh: 接下来是一节关于河流的地理课。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) points at long blue rivers on the big world map on the classroom wall.

sentences.en: Mia knows the answer and raises her hand.
sentences.zh: 米娅知道答案，举起了手。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) raises her hand high and eagerly in front of the big world map.

sentences.en: Ben writes a note with his pencil.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) writes in his notebook with a yellow pencil.

sentences.en: “For homework, test yourself,” says Mister Kofi.
sentences.zh: “回家作业是自己测验一下，”科菲先生说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) smiles and speaks to Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) as they pack their bags.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the teacher talking to the children at the end of class; the homework he gives can't be shown.
